title: This changelog
text: See what's new on Civic Charts, newest first.

title: Carousels for maps
text: Map charts now export as swipeable slides: the map, the 5 highest and 5 lowest places, the takeaway and the source. Ties are shown as ties.

title: Headlines that lead with the news
text: When a weekly number makes a big move or hits a record, the chart's headline says so ("fell 48¢ over the past 4 weeks"), computed straight from the data.

title: One-tap caption copy
text: A simple page to copy a post's caption on your phone.

title: Share to Reddit
text: The Reddit tab suggests fitting communities, including your state's for state maps, and opens the post page with the source comment copied.

title: Smoother videos
text: Videos are now drawn frame by frame, so they play smoothly on every platform.

title: Privacy and terms pages
text: Plain-language pages on what the site collects (very little) and how it can be used.

title: Fixed: loading search results on phones
AI voiceovers
text: Add a natural-sounding narrated voiceover to any chart video, written from the data.

title: Local money and climate data
text: Fair Market Rents by county, federal spending by state, temperature trends and the weekly Drought Monitor.

title: Cost-of-living data
text: Grocery prices, wages vs. inflation, rent, home affordability and electricity prices, by state and county where available.

title: A page for every chart
text: Each dataset now has its own link (civiccharts.com/gas-price/) with a summary, key facts and a preview image, plus an RSS feed of new releases.

title: Pick up where you left off
text: Reloading the page keeps your chart and settings.

title: Simple and Advanced modes
text: Simple mode gets you a finished chart in a few taps; Advanced shows every option.

title: Ready-made post text
text: Captions written for Threads, Bluesky, YouTube Shorts, Instagram, Reddit and more, sized to each platform's limits.

title: Instagram Reels and Stories sizes
text: With margins measured from the real apps, so nothing important hides under buttons.

title: Map labels
text: Place names stay readable on tall, phone-shaped maps.

title: Internet access data
text: Broadband datasets, and better-labeled results when you search other sources.

title: Plainsight is now Civic Charts
text: New name, new home at civiccharts.com.

title: Claim check
text: Every chart's text is checked against the data before you can export it. If a number doesn't match, it tells you and offers the fix.

title: More ways to share
text: LinkedIn and Facebook sizes, slides, a one-page brief, CSV data, embed code and share links that rebuild the exact chart.

title: Elections and crime data
text: County presidential results from 2000 to 2024, and FBI crime rates with how they differ from the FBI's official estimates.

title: Federal, state and local sources
text: FEMA, Census, NASA, EPA and FDA data, plus 43 state portals and 88 city, county and regional portals to search.

title: Compare datasets
text: Put two or more datasets in one chart, with a clear note on whether the comparison is fair.

title: County maps
text: Map any county-level dataset, zoom to your state, and upload your own county data.

title: Launch
text: Turn official public data into honest charts and videos for social media, with the source on every frame.
